name: Subjectivation
detailed_description:
You can't afford to look away any longer

In Subjectivation, you have to take matters into your own hands.

You tried to avert your eyes and forget what has been done. The perfectly tuned, entropy-draining electromagnetic waves caught up with you anyway. 

Now, your only option is to return to the source of the signal. What you do with this oscillator is up to you, but you simply have to do something. During your journey you’ll rediscover what fate befell the snowy town  - and use that knowledge to shape the future with your own two hands.

You can't afford to look away any longer.

And when you finally turn back, you will

  • Collect keys, find useful items, and jot down notes to help you solve puzzles that will affect the story’s outcome 

  • Fight off the town’s inhabitants warped into unrecognizable creatures by the corrupting signal

  • Manage your body heat by finding the few rare sources of warmth in this wintery town

  • Explore the town’s exteriors and interiors with your trusty lighter and notebook in hand

  • Talk to those you've wronged and find out whether you can convince them to find forgiveness in their now-frozen hearts

  • Shape the town's future with the ways you solve the puzzles and approach the conversations you will be presented with

short_description: Subjectivation is a first person horror adventure game set in a snow-covered town frozen in time. Solve puzzles, manage your body heat, and defend yourself from the warped inhabitants of the frostbitten city. Explore the town’s past - and shape its future with your actions.
